queries.ai_overview: Yes, recognised if valid where it took place and would be valid under Australian law. Rules: valid abroad; valid in Australia (18+, not already married, not closely related, free consent); no registration needed (cannot register with an Australian BDM); proof = original or certified foreign certificate, translated if needed. Limitations: overseas certificate does not automatically allow surname change on Australian ID such as a passport, may need a formal BDM name change; symbolic vs legal (legals-only in Australia first); no automatic residency. References: nsw.gov.au, smartraveller.gov.au, qld.gov.au, bdm.vic.gov.au, meillonandbright.com.au, tgb.com.au, connorhunter.com, theweddingsociety.co, idodrivethru.com.au, gotocourt.com.au, instagram.com.
